assumptions: Source rule: straight-line depreciation deducts the same amount each period: adjusted basis minus salvage value spread over the useful life (IRS Publication 946).
Application profile: straight-line book schedule for one asset population; the computers oracle uses the 5-year GDS recovery period for computers and peripheral equipment.
Second authority: GAAP ASC 360 systematic and rational allocation over benefited periods (inspected via the open PwC guide excerpt; codification full text gated).

models.inverse_notes: C = Dep * n + S given Dep, n and S; S = C - Dep * n given C, Dep and n; n = (C - S) / Dep given C, S and Dep with Dep > 0. Substitution: Dep = 2000 with S = 0 and n = 5 gives C = 10000, and forward (10000 - 0) / 5 = 2000. Zero case: Dep = 0 with C = S leaves n underdetermined (any schedule length spreads a zero amount). Untested direction: none beyond the three stated inverses.
limitations: Excludes the MACRS 200%-DB default method, half-year/mid-quarter conventions, the special (bonus) depreciation allowance and section 179 expensing.
Excludes declining-balance and MACRS table schedules (multi-period schedules, not one scalar relationship) and economic-depreciation concepts (NIPA capital consumption).
National-accounts depreciation (admitted NIPA records) is a different concept and is never bound here.

rejection_cases.reason: C < S violates the C >= S guard: a depreciable amount cannot be negative (guard-scope case).
n = 0 violates the n >= 1 guard: spreading over zero periods is undefined (domain case; also a division singularity).

relationship.locator: Straight Line Method (chapter 1) and GDS recovery table
relationship.original_equation: Annual depreciation = (asset cost - salvage value) / recovery periods (straight-line, equal annual amounts)
relationship.translation_notes: C, S and n are introduced symbols for asset cost, salvage value and recovery periods; Dep is the introduced annual amount. Dimensional check: (currency - currency) / count = currency per period, declared compound currency/count in USD/periods (USD per year). r2 dims correction (brief 28 path a): the output keeps the equation and oracle values but carries the compound dimensions and per-period unit so a per-period rate cannot mis-bind as a plain currency amount; the new unit USD/periods is an explicit vocabulary gap. The straight-line rule (subtract salvage from basis, spread evenly) is the IRS statement; the GAAP excerpt corroborates systematic allocation and an equal-amount worked example. MACRS 200%-DB, conventions, bonus allowance and section 179 are excluded scope, not expression terms.
